C1338.title: Guangzhou Customs Deploys 265 Officers to Dismantle Cross-Border Pregnant Women's Blood Sample Smuggling Rings
C1338.summary: The Guangzhou Customs Anti-Smuggling Bureau deployed 265 officers to dismantle two criminal groups specializing in smuggling pregnant women's blood samples out of the country. The groups formed a black-market chain of 'online solicitation – courier sample collection – transit storage – cross-border smuggling,' using couriers to conceal blood sample vials on their bodies or in luggage compartments,

references.title: Black-Market Chain for Smuggling Pregnant Women's Blood Samples Exposed After 7 Million Yuan in Five-Month Illegal Profits
